'''Brembo''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] whose surface consisted of [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Stone/Legends|rock]]. It was located in<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Felucia system/Legends|Felucia system]], found in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Brembo occupied the second [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Felix/Legends|Felix]] and had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brembo was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-6.<ref name="TEA" />
